paragraphs.text: 1. A MIGHTY Governor art thou, Wondrous, Destroyer of the foe,
Whose friend is never done to death, and never, never overcome.
paragraphs.original: न यस्य हन्यते सखा न जीयते कदा चन
paragraphs.translit: na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadā cana

paragraphs.text: 2. Lord of the clan, who brings us bliss, Strong, Warrior, Slayer of the fiend,
May India, Soma-drinker, go before us, Bull who gives us peace.
paragraphs.original: वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः सोमपा अभयंकरः
paragraphs.translit: vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṃkaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Drive Raksasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vrtra's jaws:
paragraphs.original: वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज ।
paragraphs.translit: vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja |

paragraphs.text: O Vrtra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us.
4. O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us:
paragraphs.original: वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः ।
paragraphs.translit: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ |

paragraphs.text: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury.
5. Baffle the foeman's plan, ward off his weapon who would conquer us.
Give shelter from his furious wrath, and keep his murdering dart afar.
paragraphs.original: वि मन्योः शर्म यच्छ वरीयो यवया वधम्
paragraphs.translit: vi manyoḥ śarma yaccha varīyo yavayā vadham
